scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.speaker: Rose
scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.text: hara do Ati-Atihan. bukon eamang pyesta, kundi kultura ag pagtuo.
scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.translation: This is the Ati-Atihan. Not just a festival, but culture and faith.

scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.speaker: Player
scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.text: It’s so lively. I’ve never seen anything like this.

scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.speaker: Kapitan Julian
scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.text: Mayad-ayad nga agahon sa atung mga bisita! Welcome sa atong pyesta.
scene_1_festival_grounds_morning.translation: Good morning, visitors! Welcome to our festival.

scene_2_parade_and_dance.speaker: Kapitan Julian
scene_2_parade_and_dance.text: do mga tawo iya ga celebrar it  Sto. Niño. bukon eamang it gasaot, kundi gapasaeamat.
scene_2_parade_and_dance.translation: The people here celebrate the Child Jesus. It’s not just dance, but thanksgiving.

scene_2_parade_and_dance.speaker: Player
scene_2_parade_and_dance.text: So it’s both religious and cultural?

scene_2_parade_and_dance.speaker: Kapitan Julian
scene_2_parade_and_dance.text: hara gid. Ang Ati-Atihan, kilaea sa bilog  nga Pilipinas.
scene_2_parade_and_dance.translation: Exactly. The Ati-Atihan is famous throughout the Philippines.

scene_3_call_and_response.speaker: Rose
scene_3_call_and_response.text: Sige, balikbayan. Samiti nga mag-sabat. Bukon it sagrado nga chant ’ra, safe eang.
scene_3_call_and_response.translation: Come on, balikbayan. Try to respond. This isn’t a sacred chant, just a safe one.

choices.label: Maybe just a little, I’m shy.
I don’t think I should, I’ll just watch.

scene_3_call_and_response.speaker: Kapitan Julian
scene_3_call_and_response.text: Mayad ! bukon ka eon outsider, apo.

scene_3_call_and_response.speaker: Rose
scene_3_call_and_response.text: Fair enough. Even a little effort counts.

scene_3_call_and_response.speaker: Kapitan Julian
scene_3_call_and_response.text: bukon problema. Respect is part of the festival too.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.text: Saot — dance. Tamboe — drum. Pyesta — festival. Kasadyahan — joy.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.text: Balikbayan — returning from abroad. Bisita — visitor. Tawo — person.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.text: Okay, so I’m the balikbayan, and everyone else is tawo.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_festiv.text: Correct. And you’re also a bisita, but now part of the kasadyahan.

scene_5_reflection.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_5_reflection.text: hindi ko gid malipatan ro adlaw ngara. Btyag ko nga Mingko unga ako uman.
scene_5_reflection.translation: I won’t forget this day. I feel like a child again.

scene_5_reflection.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_5_reflection.text: Worth every mile of travel, Ma.

scene_5_reflection.speaker: Rose
scene_5_reflection.text: And worth every word you’ve learned, balikbayan.

idle_pool_kapitan_julian.speaker: Kapitan Julian
idle_pool_kapitan_julian.text: Kada tuig, mas grabe ang preparation. Pero indi ko gid ni ibaylo sa iba.
Nag-uutos si Kapitan Julian sa mga kabataan, sabay ngiti kahit stressed.

idle_pool_kapitan_julian.speaker: Kapitan Julian
idle_pool_kapitan_julian.text: Rose says you're not bad anymore, huh. High praise, coming from her.

idle_pool_kapitan_julian.speaker: Kapitan Julian
idle_pool_kapitan_julian.text: Ang pista ni, indi lang party. Amo ni ang pagpasalamat namon, tanan tuig.
Tumigil sandali si Kapitan Julian, hinihinga nang malalim, bago bumalik sa gitna ng gulo.

idle_pool_kapitan_julian.speaker: Kapitan Julian
idle_pool_kapitan_julian.text: Kung gusto mo makakita mas damo, balik ka sa tunay nga adlaw sang pista. Ni, practice pa lang.

idle_pool_kapitan_julian.speaker: Kapitan Julian
idle_pool_kapitan_julian.text: Tanan tao diri, pamilya. Kahit indi direkta, pamilya gihapon.
Iniabot ni Kapitan Julian ang isang maliit na costume accessory kay Player, parang regalo.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag mo akong tignan nang ganyan, hindi ako tour guide. ...okay, konti lang.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka gid, ha. Indi lang basta-basta.
Tumingin si Rose sa Player nang matagal, parang sinusukat kung seryoso ba talaga siya.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: My Lola Susan talks about your Lola Jonabel parang superhero pa. Big shoes to fill, balikbayan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Fine, you're not completely hopeless. ...don't let that get to your head.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Alam mo, hindi ko rin naman gustong magturo dati. Pero, sige na nga.
Napailing si Rose, pero halatang pigil ang ngiti.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag kang mag-expect ng slack sa 'kin kasi pinsan ka daw ni Tita Susan. Rules apply to everyone.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Stop overthinking the pronunciation. Just say it. Worst case, I laugh at you.
Tumingin si Rose sa mapa, tapos kay Player, parang sinusukat ang route.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Pedring likes you. That's rare — he's picky about balikbayans.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magbulig ako sa imo, pero indi ako mangin madali. Deal pa rin 'yun.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're actually trying. Didn't expect that, not gonna lie.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: I actually like it here. Don't tell Manang Loleng I said that, she'll never let me hear the end of it.
Tinitignan ni Rose ang unang linya ng weaving ni Player, tapos tumango, medyo impressed.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're better at this than the greeting stuff, honestly. Weird flex, but okay.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka pa sang isara ka leksyon, tapos indi ka na "balikbayan" sa akon. Promise.
Nag-iisa si Rose sa dulo ng bangka, tinitignan ang tubig nang tahimik.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Ambo's basically family. He used to carry me on his shoulders here, ages ago.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: This place calms me down. Don't get used to seeing me like this though.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: This is my favorite time of year. Don't tell anyone I said that either.
Sumasayaw nang bahagya si Rose habang naglalakad, hindi napapansin.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You did better than I expected out there. Seriously.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Sunod tuig, ikaw na mismo mag-lead sang banner. Deal?

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Halong, apo — mainit gid diri sa Aklan, indi pareho sa America.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Kung gutom ka, sabihon mo lang. Damo pagkaon sa balay.
Ngumiti si Lola Susan, hinahaplos ang balikat ni Jonabel na parang natatakot pang mawala ulit ito.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Rose is a good girl, ha. Sharp lidah lang — sharp tongue. Her heart is bigger than that mouth.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Sabihin mo sa akin kung ano pa gusto mong makita dito. Ipapakita ko lahat.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Dati pa, magkasama kami ni Jonabel sa lahat. Ngayon, ikaw naman ang kasama niya.
Kinukuha ni Lola Susan ang bag ni Player nang hindi man lang pinapayagan siyang tumanggi.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Indi ka gid mabudlayan diri, Apo. Kilala ka namon tanan.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Ari, tan-awa ang simbahan. Kadamo ka gid memories diri, apo.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Halong ka lang sa init, indi ka anad diri sa Aklan.
Tumango si Lola Susan sa mga kakilala habang naglalakad papasok ng market.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Kung may gusto ka pamangkin, sabihon mo lang kay Manong Pedring. Suki namon 'to.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Rose is teaching you well, no? She's stubborn, but her heart is in the right place.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Sadto pa, amo ni akon paborito nga bahin sang tuig. Wala nagbag-o.
Kinunan ni Lola Susan ng litrato si Player habang nagpaparticipate sa call-response.
